document_metadata.title: 19、INT. A CHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Aliens escape containment, attacking personnel across the facility; Ripley laughs at the chaos, Perez discovers the breach, and Father initiates evacuation as survivors fight desperately.

entities.name: Guard unlocks cargo and removes side panel to reveal cryotubes
entities.description: A guard operates an electric lock and slides off a side panel to expose the cargo, revealing five cryotubes stacked inside the chamber.

entities.name: Cryotubes are moved and additional unit is brought into chamber
entities.description: The existing cryotubes are relocated to one side of the room to make space as a second unit containing more cryotubes is wheeled in, bringing the total to ten.

entities.name: Scientists move to adjoining observation chamber
entities.description: The scientists leave the main chamber and enter an adjacent room with a long glass window providing a view of the cryotube chamber.

entities.name: Last guard exits and chamber door locks behind them
entities.description: The final guard departs the chamber, and the door automatically locks, sealing the room.

entities.name: Wren activates cryotube release sequence
entities.description: Wren begins pressing buttons that trigger the opening of the glass tops of the cryotubes, initiating the awakening process.

entities.name: Lifesign and temperature gauges show changes in cryotubes
entities.description: Monitoring equipment indicates shifting vital signs and rising temperatures within the cryotubes, signaling the sleepers are beginning to awaken.

entities.name: Ceiling mechanism lowers and rotates with alien eggs attached
entities.description: A section of the ceiling descends and slowly rotates, positioning ten alien eggs so they are aligned above the heads of the ten sleepers.

entities.name: One sleeper briefly opens their eyes
entities.description: One of the individuals in the cryotubes shows signs of consciousness as their eyes flutter and open momentarily.

entities.name: All ten alien eggs open simultaneously
entities.description: In unison, the ten alien eggs attached to the ceiling mechanism rupture or open, initiating the next phase of the procedure.

entities.name: dark chamber
entities.description: A dimly lit room where the cryotubes are placed and the alien eggs are deployed above the sleepers.

entities.name: adjoining chamber
entities.description: A nearby room connected to the dark chamber, equipped with a glass window for observation by the scientists.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A person involved in activating the cryotube release sequence and present during the procedure with the cryotubes and alien eggs.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Gediman
entities.description: An individual who appears nervous and uncertain about the ongoing procedure involving the cryotubes and alien eggs.
entities.summary: Scientists conduct medical and behavioral analysis on Ripley and a cloned specimen, monitoring health, memory, and mutation risks, while collaborating with Wren and addressing ethical concerns about termination.

entities.name: guard

entities.summary: Ten organic pods attached to a ceiling mechanism, each positioned above a sleeper and later revealed to open simultaneously.

entities.name: temperature and lifesign gauges

entities.name: Scientists

entities.summary: A group of researchers who observe the procedure from an adjoining chamber equipped with a viewing window.

entities.name: Johner challenges Ripley to a one-on-one basketball game
entities.description: Johner approaches Ripley in the conference hall, smiling, and tauntingly asks her to play a one-on-one basketball game, persisting despite her clear disinterest.

entities.name: Ripley physically repels Johner's advances
entities.description: In response to Johner's persistent provocation, Ripley strikes him in the chest with enough force to send him flying into a group of chairs, initiating a physical confrontation.

entities.name: Crew members attack Ripley in retaliation
entities.description: After Johner is knocked down, his crewmates Christie and Hillard immediately retaliate—Hillard jumps Ripley from behind, and Christie swings at her with an ashtray, striking her in the face.

entities.name: Ripley overpowers Christie and defends herself
entities.description: Ripley quickly recovers from Christie's blow, lunges at him, grabs him by the throat, and knocks away the ashtray he attempts to use, sustaining only a minor nosebleed.

entities.name: Ripley subdues Johner in a violent assault
entities.description: When Johner attacks her again, Ripley leaps on him, throws him to the ground, and begins snarling as if about to rip out his throat with her teeth, demonstrating extreme aggression.

entities.name: Crew Meal Gathering In The Conference Hall
entities.description: The crew of the Betty assembles in the conference hall for a meal, using the repurposed space with tables and chairs set up at one end, indicating a routine social occasion aboard the ship.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. A CHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Aliens escape containment, attacking personnel across the facility; Ripley laughs at the chaos, Perez discovers the breach, and Father initiates evacuation as survivors fight desperately.

entities.name: Ripley awakens abruptly from a nightmare in her chamber
entities.description: Ripley suddenly wakes up in her chamber, breathing hard and disoriented, showing signs of distress from a nightmare, then gradually calms and resigns herself back to sleep.

entities.name: Call loses poker hand and reacts to Johner's moonshine
entities.description: Call folds her cards during a tense poker game, drinks from Johner's moonshine, reacts to its terrible taste, and attempts to leave the table.

entities.name: St Just wins poker hand by bluffing with undisclosed cards
entities.description: St Just raises the bet, causes other players to fold, and wins the pot without revealing his hand, prompting Johner to call him an asshole.

entities.name: Call stumbles and falls while leaving the mess hall
entities.description: After attempting to stand up from the poker table, Call loses her balance, falls over her chair, and exits the room unsteadily, drawing laughter from the others.

entities.name: Johner deals next hand of eight-card throwback poker
entities.description: After the previous hand concludes, Johner shuffles the deck and begins dealing the next round of poker, declaring the game rules with irreverent flair.

entities.name: Poker Game In The Mess Hall
entities.description: A prolonged, informal poker game attended by Christie, Call, St Just, and Johner, involving alcohol, banter, and high-stakes play during the night hours.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. A CHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Aliens escape containment, attacking personnel across the facility; Ripley laughs at the chaos, Perez discovers the breach, and Father initiates evacuation as survivors fight desperately.

entities.name: Ripley impales her hand with Call's stiletto blade
entities.description: Ripley deliberately pushes her palm onto the stiletto blade wielded by Call, allowing it to pass completely through her hand as a demonstration of endurance or defiance.

entities.name: Ripley reveals she is a lab-grown construct of Ellen Ripley
entities.description: Ripley confirms Call's accusation that she is not the original Ellen Ripley but a biological construct created from her, raising questions about her identity and humanity.

entities.name: Ripley reveals the alien beast is dormant within her consciousness
entities.description: Ripley discloses that the alien entity is not physically unleashed but resides in her mind, influencing her thoughts and inevitable to emerge due to human actions.

entities.name: Ripley threatens Call by touching her forehead after a simulated attack
entities.description: Ripley raises her hand toward Call's head, causing her to flinch, then gently touches her forehead while delivering a cryptic warning about the inevitability of the alien's return.

entities.name: Ripley chokes Call and then releases her
entities.description: Ripley suddenly grabs Call by the throat, restrains her attempt to strike back, and squeezes her neck before letting go, allowing Call to flee.

entities.name: Call flees after being released by Ripley
entities.description: After being released from Ripley's chokehold, Call gasps for air and quickly escapes the scene as Ripley warns her that others are coming for her.

entities.name: two hundred years ago
entities.description: A relative time expression indicating when Ellen Ripley died, used to anchor past events in the narrative.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A character who engages with Ripley in a tense confrontation, attempting to reason with her and offering to end her suffering, while fearing the alien beast within her.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A lab-grown construct based on the original Ellen Ripley, possessing her memories and identity, but harboring the dormant alien beast within her consciousness.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Stiletto
entities.description: A retractable blade concealed in Call's arm, used as a weapon during her confrontation with Ripley.
entities.summary: A retractable blade concealed in Call's arm, used as a weapon during her confrontation with Ripley.

entities.name: banned histories
entities.description: A collection of suppressed historical records that include information about Ellen Ripley and the events surrounding the alien creature.

entities.name: Lab-Grown Construct
entities.description: A synthetic human created in a laboratory using genetic and technological means, designed to replicate or emulate a former individual.
entities.summary: A synthetic human created in a laboratory using genetic and technological means, designed to replicate or emulate a former individual.

entities.name: Aliens
entities.description: A hostile extraterrestrial lifeform that was originally contained within Ripley but is now partially awakened and resides within her consciousness.
entities.summary: A hostile extraterrestrial lifeform that was originally contained within Ripley but is now partially awakened and resides within her consciousness.

entities.name: Guards strike Call with a rifle butt and seize her
entities.description: Immediately after Call exits into the hall, a guard strikes her in the head with a rifle butt, knocking her down, and two guards grab and restrain her.

entities.name: Wren orders guards to sound the alarm and round up the crew
entities.description: Wren confronts Call and declares her actions ill-advised, then commands the guards to sound the alarm and capture the rest of her crew members.

entities.name: Soldiers kick over the card table and force crew members into the mess hall
entities.description: In the mess hall, soldiers violently disrupt the room by kicking over a card table and forcibly gathering Elgyn, Hillard, Rane, Christie, St Just, Johner, and Call into the space.

entities.name: Johner resists soldiers and demands to be released
entities.description: As soldiers herd the crew into the mess hall, Johner shouts at a soldier to remove his hands and shows active resistance to being restrained.

entities.name: Elgyn demands explanation from Wren while being held
entities.description: Elgyn, confused and agitated, questions Wren about the sudden betrayal and urges him to communicate the problem calmly.

entities.name: Wren orders a guard to retrieve the general and wake him
entities.description: Wren, frustrated by the lack of cooperation, silences Elgyn and commands a guard to bring the general immediately, insisting he be awakened.

entities.name: Security Raid And Crew Detention Operation
entities.description: A coordinated military-style operation led by Wren in which Call and the rest of the crew are captured, restrained, and gathered in the mess hall under armed guard.
entities.summary: A coordinated military-style operation led by Wren in which Call and the rest of the crew are captured, restrained, and gathered in the mess hall under armed guard.

entities.name: Hall
entities.description: An interior hallway where Call is attacked by guards and detained.

entities.name: Mess Hall
entities.description: An interior room where crew members are gathered and detained by soldiers.

entities.name: Moments later
entities.description: A short, relative temporal anchor indicating the scene follows closely after the previous one.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A commanding figure leading guards and soldiers during a security operation, giving orders to round up crew members and retrieve the general.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Elgyn
entities.description: A crew member who is detained and demands explanation from Wren during the security raid.
entities.summary: A fifty-year-old leader with silver hair oversees docking and crew security, shares a close bond with Hillard, and manages operations aboard the Auriga, where a sarcastic crew member questions security while another is detained during a raid.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who resists soldiers during detention and demands to be released.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A crew member who observes the situation in the mess hall and comments on it being a doublecross.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: St Just

entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A crew member who is pushed into the mess hall during the security operation, appearing sleepy and confused.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.description: A crew member who is pushed into the mess hall during the security operation, appearing sleepy and confused.
entities.summary: A quiet crew member aboard the Auriga, involved in the night cycle and security chaos, is questioned about mobility, survives initial encounters, and later expresses concern about alien creatures, suggesting military backup before being killed in a firefight.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. A CHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Aliens escape containment, attacking personnel across the facility; Ripley laughs at the chaos, Perez discovers the breach, and Father initiates evacuation as survivors fight desperately.

entities.name: St Just disarms and kills multiple guards with precision
entities.description: St Just rapidly raises his hands and shoots down several guards, killing two immediately and a third without looking in their direction, during a violent confrontation.

entities.name: Guard shoots and kills Rane with a burner
entities.description: One of the remaining guards fires a shot with his weapon, killing Rane before being incapacitated by Hillard.

entities.name: Hillard incapacitates guard with elbow strike
entities.description: After the guard shoots Rane, Hillard attacks him with a forceful elbow strike that drives the guard's teeth into his throat, rendering him incapacitated.

entities.name: Christie tackles an advancing guard
entities.description: As another guard moves in, Christie intercepts by tackling him to the ground during the chaotic firefight.

entities.name: Johner reveals hidden gun in thermos and shoots guard through container
entities.description: Johner activates a latch on his thermos, revealing a concealed firearm inside, and fires through the thermos body to kill a fleeing guard.

entities.name: Alarms activate and guards respond to disturbance in Sector Two
entities.description: In the alien observation lab, red alarms and flashing lights signal an emergency, prompting Gediman to dispatch most of the guards to investigate Sector Two.

entities.name: Gediman monitors security footage of unfolding conflict
entities.description: Gediman watches the chaotic confrontation on surveillance monitors in the observation lab, attempting to assess the situation as it unfolds.

entities.name: St Just holds Wren hostage and aims at remaining guards
entities.description: After the firefight, St Just places a gun to Wren's head while simultaneously aiming another weapon at the two surviving guards, asserting control over the scene.

entities.name: Johner and St Just cover remaining guards in standoff
entities.description: With St Just holding Wren and aiming at the guards, Johner also takes aim, ensuring both remaining guards are under armed threat in the aftermath of the battle.

entities.name: Elgyn阻止s Call from leaving by grabbing her hair
entities.description: As Call attempts to walk away, Elgyn forcefully grabs her by the hair and pulls her back, preventing her from exiting the mess hall.

entities.name: Alien Observation Lab
entities.description: An interior setting where Gediman monitors security footage, indicated by the scene heading and context of surveillance equipment.

entities.name: CONTINUOUS
entities.description: A scene-anchoring temporal marker indicating the action proceeds without time gap from the previous scene.

entities.name: Mess Hall
entities.description: An interior setting where the confrontation unfolds after the firefight, specified in the scene heading.

entities.name: St Just
entities.description: A skilled combatant who disarms and kills multiple guards with precision and takes Wren hostage during a standoff.
entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A participant in the confrontation who threatens others with execution and is later taken hostage by St Just.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Elgyn
entities.description: An individual who restrains Call from leaving by grabbing her hair and challenges her during the conflict.
entities.summary: A fifty-year-old leader with silver hair oversees docking and crew security, shares a close bond with Hillard, and manages operations aboard the Auriga, where a sarcastic crew member questions security while another is detained during a raid.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A woman who attempts to leave the scene to 'finish this' but is physically stopped by Elgyn.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Rane
entities.description: An individual who is shot and killed by a guard using a burner during the firefight.
entities.summary: A quiet crew member aboard the Auriga, involved in the night cycle and security chaos, is questioned about mobility, survives initial encounters, and later expresses concern about alien creatures, suggesting military backup before being killed in a firefight.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A participant in the conflict who incapacitates a guard with an elbow strike after the guard shoots Rane.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: An individual who tackles an advancing guard during the chaotic confrontation in the mess hall.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A man who reveals a hidden gun inside a thermos and uses it to shoot a guard through the container.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Gediman
entities.description: A person monitoring security footage from the Alien Observation Lab who dispatches guards to Sector Two.
entities.summary: Scientists conduct medical and behavioral analysis on Ripley and a cloned specimen, monitoring health, memory, and mutation risks, while collaborating with Wren and addressing ethical concerns about termination.

entities.name: thermos with hidden gun
entities.description: A thermos modified to conceal a firearm inside, used by Johner to surprise and kill a guard.

entities.name: burner
entities.description: A type of weapon used by a guard to shoot and kill Rane during the firefight.

entities.name: guns in sleeves
entities.description: Two concealed firearms that St Just releases from his sleeves and uses to kill multiple guards.

entities.name: Two aliens attack and kill the third alien in the pen
entities.description: The two surviving aliens in the observation pen suddenly turn on the third, tearing it apart limb from limb while emitting piercing shrieks, marking a coordinated and violent act.

entities.name: Alien blood corrodes through the floor and multiple levels
entities.description: The blood of the dismembered alien reacts violently with the floor, burning a hole through it and continuing down through at least two additional levels of the facility.

entities.name: Gediman activates failsafe freezing gas after breach
entities.description: Gediman rushes to the failsafe controls and triggers the release of freezing gas into the observation pen, but it fills an empty chamber as the aliens have already escaped.

entities.name: Two aliens escape through hole created by corrosive blood
entities.description: Immediately after the blood eats through the floor, the two aliens dive through the hole and escape the observation pen before the failsafe can contain them.

entities.name: Alien ambushes and kills Gediman by pulling him through floor hole
entities.description: As Gediman looks down into the hole, an alien that had been clinging beneath the lower level ceiling suddenly flies up, grabs him, and pulls him through the hole before he can scream.

entities.name: Guard frozen in shock after witnessing alien attack
entities.description: After the alien kills Gediman and disappears through the hole, the guard remains motionless, visibly shaking and unable to react, overwhelmed by terror.

entities.name: Observation Lab
entities.description: The physical setting where the aliens are contained and observed, and where the breach begins.

entities.name: pen
entities.description: The enclosed area within the Observation Lab where the aliens are held and where the attack on the third alien takes place.

entities.name: guard
entities.description: A security guard present in the Observation Lab who witnesses the alien breach and is left frozen in shock after the attack on Gediman.

entities.name: freezing gas
entities.description: A failsafe gas system activated by Gediman to contain the alien threat in the Observation Lab.

entities.name: pool of alien blood
entities.description: Corrosive blood from the killed alien that eats through the floor and multiple levels of the facility.

entities.name: failsafe system
entities.description: A security mechanism in the Observation Lab designed to contain alien breaches, including freezing gas and emergency protocols.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. A CHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Aliens escape containment, attacking personnel across the facility; Ripley laughs at the chaos, Perez discovers the breach, and Father initiates evacuation as survivors fight desperately.

entities.name: Johner threatens Call at gunpoint
entities.description: Johner presses his firearm against Call's temple and offers to make the situation 'simple,' escalating the tension among the group.

entities.name: Johner forces Wren to comply by shoving gun in his mouth
entities.description: In response to rising conflict, Johner physically intimidates Wren by shoving his gun into Wren's mouth and ordering him to drop his weapons.

entities.name: Call declares intent to stop an imminent threat
entities.description: Call asserts that she must intervene to prevent a catastrophic outcome that would result in the group's death if she fails.

entities.name: Distant scream interrupts the confrontation
entities.description: A scream from afar abruptly halts the escalating standoff, drawing the attention of all present and shifting the atmosphere to one of dread.

entities.name: Wren demands information from Elgyn about Call's involvement
entities.description: Wren, after being threatened, turns to Elgyn and insists on knowing whether Call is acting alone in whatever plan or danger is unfolding.

entities.name: Christie points out the consequences of dead soldiers
entities.description: Christie highlights the presence of dead soldiers, arguing that regardless of Call's motives, the group is now in serious danger.

entities.name: Two additional guards enter the mess hall
entities.description: Amid the escalating tension, two more guards arrive in the mess hall, increasing the potential for violence.

entities.name: MESS HALL
entities.description: An interior room in a facility where the confrontation takes place, specifically identified as a mess hall.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A crew member present during the confrontation in the mess hall who expresses concern over the dead soldiers and the group's survival.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Elgyn
entities.description: A crew member involved in the standoff who questions Call's involvement in a hidden agenda.
entities.summary: A fifty-year-old leader with silver hair oversees docking and crew security, shares a close bond with Hillard, and manages operations aboard the Auriga, where a sarcastic crew member questions security while another is detained during a raid.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A crew member who is physically threatened by Johner and demands information about Call's role in the unfolding situation.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who escalates the tension by threatening Wren and Call with a gun during the confrontation.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member who asserts the need to stop an imminent threat to prevent everyone's death.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A crew member who questions Wren about what Call might be involved in during the standoff.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: gun
entities.description: A firearm used by Johner to threaten Wren and Call during the confrontation in the mess hall.

entities.name: dead soldiers
entities.description: The bodies of soldiers whose deaths are cited by Christie as evidence of the group's dire situation.

entities.name: mexican standoff
entities.description: A tense confrontation in which multiple parties are at odds, each threatening force, creating a deadlock situation.

entities.name: Alien attacks technician in hallway by labs
entities.description: An alien leaps onto a technician from behind in the hallway near the labs, attacking him as he runs and screams.

entities.name: Guard fires at alien escaping into airvent
entities.description: A guard in the adjacent hallway fires wildly at the ceiling as an alien disappears into an airvent, indicating ongoing combat and pursuit.

entities.name: Aliens escape from containment pens
entities.description: The aliens have broken free from their enclosures, evidenced by smoke, dead bodies, and a cracked, open plexiglass partition in one of the cages.

entities.name: Ripley laughs amid incoming chaos
entities.description: Sitting alone in the dark of her cell, Ripley begins to laugh as the sounds of chaos and violence start to filter in from around the facility.

entities.name: Perez attempts to obtain damage report during crisis
entities.description: Perez, half-dressed and disoriented, stands at the command console trying to get a response from the ensign for a damage report but receives no reply.

entities.name: Perez observes alien on surveillance screen
entities.description: While reviewing security feeds, Perez sees an alien briefly appear on one of the monitors, causing him to stiffen in shock and fear.

entities.name: Perez views wounded lieutenant reporting containment failure
entities.description: Perez switches to a feed showing a badly wounded lieutenant who reports that containment is impossible and suspects the aliens have swept the barracks.

entities.name: Perez initiates emergency override procedures
entities.description: After realizing the severity of the situation, Perez begins entering emergency override codes into the system in an attempt to regain control.

entities.name: Alien ambushes soldier attempting to access weapons cabinet
entities.description: In the barracks, a soldier running toward the weapons cabinet is attacked from behind by an alien and smashed into the cabinet, causing a cascade of falling guns.

entities.name: Emergency lighting activates to guide evacuation
entities.description: Amid the chaos in the barracks, emergency floor lighting turns on, illuminating paths toward the nearest exits to facilitate evacuation.

entities.name: Father announces mandatory evacuation over intercom
entities.description: Through the intercom system, Father's calm voice declares a full emergency and orders all personnel to initiate evacuation procedures immediately, stating it is not a drill.

entities.name: Soldier's weapon fire injures alien and kills comrades
entities.description: A soldier manages to shoot an alien with a burner, temporarily injuring it but also killing two fellow soldiers in the process.

entities.name: Alien kills soldier after being shot
entities.description: After being briefly stunned by gunfire, the alien recovers and attacks the soldier who shot it, killing him by destroying his face.

entities.name: HALLWAY BY LABS
entities.description: A hallway adjacent to the laboratories where an alien attacks a technician and a guard fires at an escaping alien.

entities.name: THE PENS
entities.description: Containment area where the aliens were held and from which they have escaped, marked by smoke, dead bodies, and a damaged cage.

entities.name: RIPLEY'S CELL
entities.description: The confined space where Ripley is held and where she laughs as chaos begins to unfold.

entities.name: PEREZ'S QUARTERS
entities.description: Perez's personal living area equipped with a command console, used to monitor the crisis and initiate emergency procedures.

entities.name: BARRACKS
entities.description: Sleeping quarters where multiple soldiers are killed by aliens, and survivors attempt to arm themselves amid chaos.

entities.name: CONTINUOUS
entities.description: Indicates that the scene unfolds in immediate temporal continuity with the preceding action, without time lapse.

entities.name: General Perez
entities.description: A commanding officer who responds to the crisis by attempting to obtain a damage report, observing the alien on surveillance, and initiating emergency override procedures.
entities.summary: General Perez oversees Ripley's test with suspicion; a scientist questions cloning and genetic memory, while a decision-maker authorizes containment due to specimen concerns, and crew discuss security and operational details.

entities.name: Father
entities.description: A figure who announces the mandatory evacuation over the intercom with a calm voice amid the chaos.
entities.summary:
The voice of the ship, providing authoritative confirmation of security status in a calm, synthetic tone.

document_metadata.title: 20、INT. HALLWAY BY ENGINE ROOM - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: Crew encounters locked door; forced to reroute through holding cells due to breached hull, with Johner threatening a soldier under Wren's direction.

entities.name: Vriess wheels into the hall and observes emergency lighting
entities.description: Vriess enters the hall cautiously, noting the activated emergency lights and the absence of sound, and slowly spins to assess his surroundings.

entities.name: Alien blood drips from ceiling, Vriess narrowly avoids contact
entities.description: A drop of corrosive alien blood falls from above; Vriess notices in time, rolls out of the way, and avoids injury as the blood eats through the floor.

entities.name: Soldiers rush into lifeboat one and are secured by Perez
entities.description: Men enter the first lifeboat, sit down, and strap in under Perez's direction as he pushes back those attempting to overcrowd the vessel.

entities.name: Perez seals lifeboat one and initiates ejection
entities.description: After ensuring the lifeboat is properly loaded, Perez closes the hatch and activates the eject sequence before stepping back.

entities.name: Lifeboat one launches from the Auriga
entities.description: The first lifeboat detaches from the side of the Auriga and fires away into space.

entities.name: Alien invades lifeboat two and attacks occupants
entities.description: As men fill the second lifeboat, an alien leaps inside and begins feeding on the strapped-in soldiers, causing panic and screams.

entities.name: Soldier shoots alien in lifeboat two, triggering sparks
entities.description: A soldier outside the lifeboat fires his burner at the alien, hitting it, the men inside, and the control panel, resulting in a shower of sparks.

entities.name: Soldier throws grenade and lifeboat two ejects
entities.description: As the alien turns toward the soldier, he rolls a grenade into the lifeboat before the doors close and another soldier triggers ejection.

entities.name: Lifeboat two explodes after ejection
entities.description: Shortly after launching from the Auriga, the second lifeboat detonates in space.

entities.name: Group reacts to explosion noise in mess hall
entities.description: The sound of external and internal explosions reverberates through the mess hall, startling the group gathered there.

entities.name: Wren confronts Call about the alien outbreak
entities.description: Wren accuses Call of causing the disaster, to which Call responds that he did nothing and blames Wren's belief in controlling the creature.

entities.name: Elgyn decides to head to the Betty with Rane
entities.description: Elgyn announces the plan to reach the Betty, checks if Rane can walk, and prepares the group for departure.

entities.name: DiStephano demands Wren's release during evacuation
entities.description: DiStephano intervenes, telling Elgyn to let Wren go, asserting there is no quarrel, but Elgyn refuses until they reach safety.

entities.name: Group departs mess hall, dragging Wren along
entities.description: The group begins moving toward the Betty, forcibly taking Wren with them while keeping weapons trained on Call and the soldiers.

entities.name: Johner dismisses concern for Vriess
entities.description: When someone raises the question of Vriess's safety, Johner responds with indifference, telling the group to leave him behind.

entities.name: Emergency Evacuation Of The Auriga
entities.description: A coordinated but chaotic effort to abandon the Auriga spacecraft due to alien threats, involving multiple lifeboats and personnel across different sections of the ship.
entities.summary: A coordinated but chaotic effort to abandon the Auriga spacecraft due to alien threats, involving multiple lifeboats and personnel across different sections of the ship.

entities.summary: The primary spacecraft setting where the evacuation and alien outbreak are taking place.

entities.name: bay three

entities.name: Betty
entities.description: A spacecraft referenced as the destination for the group's escape from the Auriga.
entities.summary: The spacecraft, piloted by Call, serves as the primary setting for the crew's escape, housing Vriess, Johner, Call, and the baby alien during the scene.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A character who wheels into the hall and narrowly avoids being hit by alien blood dripping from the ceiling.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: General Perez
entities.description: A soldier who directs personnel during the evacuation, secures lifeboat one, and attempts to manage the crisis in lifeboat bay one and bay three.
entities.summary: General Perez oversees Ripley's test with suspicion; a scientist questions cloning and genetic memory, while a decision-maker authorizes containment due to specimen concerns, and crew discuss security and operational details.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A character confronted by Call about the alien outbreak and later dragged along by the group during evacuation.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A character accused by Wren of causing the alien outbreak and who claims knowledge of the path to the Betty.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Elgyn
entities.description: A character who decides to head to the Betty with Rane and insists on keeping Wren until they escape.
entities.summary: A fifty-year-old leader with silver hair oversees docking and crew security, shares a close bond with Hillard, and manages operations aboard the Auriga, where a sarcastic crew member questions security while another is detained during a raid.

entities.name: Rane
entities.description: A character questioned by Elgyn about mobility and who nods and stands to indicate he can walk.
entities.summary: A quiet crew member aboard the Auriga, involved in the night cycle and security chaos, is questioned about mobility, survives initial encounters, and later expresses concern about alien creatures, suggesting military backup before being killed in a firefight.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A character who expresses concern about the danger of traveling across the ship to reach the Betty.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: Di Stephano
entities.description: A soldier who demands Wren's release during the evacuation and insists there should be no quarrel.
entities.summary: A group including soldiers, crew, and guards attempts to evacuate Wren amid system restrictions, using alternate escape routes while confirming autopilot protocols and advancing cautiously downward.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A character who dismisses concern for Vriess during the group's departure.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Vriess enters the hall and notices pulsing lights
entities.description: Vriess enters a hallway, visibly unsettled, and observes the lights on the floor pulsing, which seem to influence his movement.

entities.name: Alien stirs in the rafters above Vriess
entities.description: An alien creature, coiled around the pipes in the ceiling, begins to move as Vriess advances through the hall.

entities.name: Alien climbs toward Vriess on the ceiling pipes
entities.description: The alien descends and moves rapidly upside down along the pipes, advancing toward Vriess with clear intent.

entities.name: Vriess retreats from the approaching alien
entities.description: Realizing the danger, Vriess begins to wheel himself backward away from the alien, moving slowly and with difficulty.

entities.name: Vriess turns and flees down the hall
entities.description: After reaching a corner, Vriess turns and begins moving quickly down the fifty-foot hall toward the far end where soldiers are present.

entities.name: Soldier attempts to seal off the sector
entities.description: A soldier responds to the sergeant's order by rushing to the door controls to close and secure the area.

entities.name: Vriess shouts a warning to the soldier
entities.description: Vriess yells 'No!' in desperation upon seeing the soldier about to close the door, trying to prevent being locked out.

entities.name: Alien rounds the corner and chases Vriess
entities.description: The alien reaches the corner of the hall and rapidly bolts after Vriess, initiating a direct pursuit.

document_metadata.summary: Crew encounters locked door; forced to reroute through holding cells due to breached hull, with Johner threatening a soldier under Wren's direction.

entities.name: Perez attempts to maintain order in lifeboat bay during crisis

entities.name: Alien attacks from ceiling and soldiers scatter

entities.description: A crew member who gives orders and makes decisions during the crisis, including directing others to open doors and choose alternate routes.
entities.summary: A fifty-year-old leader with silver hair oversees docking and crew security, shares a close bond with Hillard, and manages operations aboard the Auriga, where a sarcastic crew member questions security while another is detained during a raid.

entities.description: A crew member tasked with opening locked doors but reports being unable to do so due to system restrictions.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who threatens a soldier with a gun when orders are not followed, showing aggressive behavior under pressure.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A crew member who explains the reason for the locked door and provides an alternative route through the holding cells.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

document_metadata.title: 21、INT. CHAMBER - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group advances through a trashed lab with three dead bodies; Ripley remains calm despite the horror, revealing she previously died confronting the creatures, as they press on toward their ship to stop the alien threat.

entities.name: Alien attacks Elgyn with tongue through skull
entities.description: An alien creature drops from the rafters and impales Elgyn's skull with its tongue, killing him instantly while Hillard witnesses the gruesome act.

entities.description: The alien leaps toward Ripley, who grabs it mid-air and hurls it away with great force, demonstrating unexpected strength.

entities.description: The alien quickly recovers, jumps at Ripley, knocks her back into the room, pins her down, and thrusts its piston-like tongue toward her face.

document_metadata.title: 21、INT. CHAMBER - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group advances through a trashed lab with three dead bodies; Ripley remains calm despite the horror, revealing she previously died confronting the creatures, as they press on toward their ship to stop the alien threat.

entities.name: Group approaches elevator bank and takes cover as elevator arrives
entities.description: The group moves quietly through the cellblock toward a bank of elevators, but before proceeding, they take cover as the elevator lights indicate an arrival, preparing for potential threat.

entities.name: Vriess emerges from darkened elevator in armed and agitated state
entities.description: The elevator doors open to reveal Vriess sitting in a chair inside, illuminated by sparks from broken overhead wiring, holding two shotguns and appearing highly agitated, startling the group.

entities.name: Johner reveals Call is a suspected spy to Vriess
entities.description: Johner informs Vriess that Call is a mole, a revelation that visibly shocks Vriess more than the prior dangers they have faced.

entities.name: Christie redirects group focus to mission after confrontation
entities.description: After tensions rise over Call's suspected identity, Christie intervenes to refocus the group on their immediate objective, prompting them to continue moving.

entities.name: Group examines holographic ship schematic at console
entities.description: The group gathers around a console displaying a detailed hologram of the ship, which shows structural integrity, interior layouts, and damaged sections.

entities.name: Wren identifies multiple hull breaches on ship schematic
entities.description: Wren points out areas of hull breach on the holographic display, including locations near lifeboats on level five and close to the engine room, indicating severe damage.

entities.name: Christie proposes escape via the Betty after confirming dock integrity
entities.description: Christie inquires about the status of their ship, the Betty, and upon learning the dock is intact, advocates for making their way toward it as an escape plan.

entities.name: Johner expresses concern about alien presence on the Betty
entities.description: Johner questions whether they can track the creatures and voices fear that even if they reach the Betty, it may already be infested.

entities.name: Wren assesses threat concentration in aft-sector of the ship
entities.description: Wren observes that all hostile activity has been localized in the aft-sector near the barracks, suggesting it is unlikely the creatures have spread to other areas like the Betty.

entities.name: CELLBLOCK
entities.description: A section of the facility where the group moves quietly and takes cover near elevators.

entities.name: maintenance
entities.description: A specific area within the facility where Vriess claims to have been during his absence.

entities.name: GUARDS, STATION
entities.description: An interior location where the group examines a holographic ship schematic at a console.

entities.name: MOMENTS LATER
entities.description: A short relative temporal marker indicating the scene continues shortly after the previous events.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A crew member who emerges from a darkened elevator in an armed and agitated state, having been previously believed to be dead.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A skeptical and confrontational crew member who accuses Call of being a spy and expresses concern about alien threats.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member suspected of being a spy, whose loyalty is questioned by Johner and met with shock by Vriess.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A mission-focused crew member who redirects the group's attention to their objective after interpersonal conflict arises.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A crew member responsible for assessing ship damage and providing tactical analysis regarding hull breaches and alien activity.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Annalee
entities.description: A crew member acknowledged by Vriess upon his emergence from the elevator, indicating a prior relationship or familiarity.

entities.name: ST JUST
entities.description: A crew member who responds sarcastically to the assessment of their situation, indicating skepticism or dark humor.

entities.name: Rane
entities.description: A crew member who challenges Johner's objections with a confrontational remark during the discussion about escape plans.
entities.summary: A quiet crew member aboard the Auriga, involved in the night cycle and security chaos, is questioned about mobility, survives initial encounters, and later expresses concern about alien creatures, suggesting military backup before being killed in a firefight.

entities.name: shotgun
entities.description: A firearm carried by Vriess, one of two he holds upon emerging from the elevator in a tense confrontation.

entities.name: holographic ship schematic
entities.description: A three-dimensional projection of the ship displayed at a console, used to identify structural damage and plan escape routes.

entities.name: oxidation systems
entities.description: Mechanical systems in the maintenance area that Vriess claims to have been inspecting prior to rejoining the group.

entities.name: mole
entities.description: A label used to describe a suspected spy within the group, specifically applied to Call, triggering tension and distrust.

entities.name: conspiracy
entities.description: An alleged secret plot involving Call and others, mentioned by Johner as the reason for suspicion aboard the ship.

entities.name: Ripley reveals aliens are breeding and will stay close to the group
entities.description: Ripley informs the group that the aliens are breeding rapidly using cloned cells, implying they will remain nearby to protect their new hosts, increasing the urgency to escape.

entities.name: Wren explains accelerated alien breeding due to cloned cells
entities.description: Wren elaborates on Ripley's warning, stating that the alien reproduction process has sped up because of the use of cloned human cells, reducing the time available for safe movement.

entities.name: Johner suggests abandoning Vriess to move faster
entities.description: Johner proposes that the group leave Vriess behind to improve their travel speed, showing disregard for her condition, though he adds a superficial 'no offense'.

entities.name: Vriess responds to Johner's insult with silent defiance
entities.description: In response to Johner's suggestion to abandon her, Vriess gives him the finger, expressing her anger and resistance without speaking.

entities.name: Hillard asserts no one will be left behind
entities.description: Hillard firmly declares that the group will not abandon anyone, including Johner himself, reinforcing unity and moral stance amid rising tension.

entities.name: DiStephano proposes using the lift shaft and maintenance tunnel for escape
entities.description: DiStephano identifies a potential escape route through the lift shaft and a maintenance access tunnel above level one deck, which could lead directly to the dock.

entities.name: Wren offers to override the access tunnel door security
entities.description: When DiStephano mentions lacking the code for the maintenance tunnel door, Wren volunteers to bypass the security system and gain entry.

entities.name: Group plans escape route through labs, kitchen, and lift shaft to the Betty
entities.description: The group finalizes a tentative escape path involving the labs, kitchen, lift shaft, and maintenance tunnel to reach the Betty, aiming to avoid alien-infested areas.

entities.name: Hours
entities.description: A short temporal reference indicating the breeding process takes only a few hours, anchoring the urgency of the scene.

entities.name: lift shaft
entities.description: A vertical shaft housing the lift, serving as a physical pathway in the escape plan.

entities.name: maintenance access tunnel
entities.description: A confined passage above level one deck, connected to the lift shaft, used for maintenance and part of the escape route.

entities.name: engineering
entities.description: A section of the ship at the bottom of the lift shaft, indicating a key structural zone in the vessel's layout.

entities.name: dock

document_metadata.title: 21、INT. CHAMBER - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group advances through a trashed lab with three dead bodies; Ripley remains calm despite the horror, revealing she previously died confronting the creatures, as they press on toward their ship to stop the alien threat.

entities.name: Vriess retrieves hidden weapons from his chair
entities.description: Vriess unloads additional ammunition and weapons, including a grenade launcher, from a concealed compartment in his chair.

entities.name: Vriess tosses a shotgun to Hillard
entities.description: Vriess throws one of his shotguns to Hillard without any sign of camaraderie or warmth.

entities.name: Vriess tosses the grenade launcher to Call
entities.description: Vriess throws a compact grenade launcher to Call, warning her not to shoot herself.

entities.name: Wren reveals aliens bleed molecular acid
entities.description: Wren informs the group that the aliens exude molecular acid when injured, making internal gunfire dangerous.

entities.name: Christie confirms alien acid bleeding
entities.description: Christie corroborates Wren's claim, stating she has personally witnessed the aliens bleeding molecular acid.

entities.name: Vriess confirms alien acid bleeding
entities.description: Vriess affirms that he has also seen the aliens bleed molecular acid, supporting Wren's warning.

entities.name: Johner declares intent to shoot aliens despite risks
entities.description: Johner dismisses concerns about the consequences and insists he will shoot the aliens regardless.

entities.name: Wren explains ship's autopilot behavior after damage
entities.description: Wren explains that the ship automatically pilots itself back to homebase when it sustains serious damage.

entities.name: Distephano confirms ship's autopilot protocol
entities.description: Distephano verifies Wren's explanation, confirming that the ship initiates an automatic return to homebase after critical damage.

entities.name: Call discovers the ship has been moving since the attack
entities.description: Call accesses the ship's computer and confirms that it has been in motion since the alien attack began.

entities.name: Wren admits forgetting to mention the autopilot
entities.description: When confronted by Call, Wren acknowledges he forgot to inform the group about the ship's autopilot function.

entities.name: Hillard asks for clarification on homebase location
entities.description: Hillard questions where the ship is heading, prompting Wren to reveal the destination is Earth.

entities.name: Wren reveals the ship is heading to Earth
entities.description: Wren discloses that the ship's homebase, and current destination, is Earth.

entities.name: Johner expresses refusal to go to Earth
entities.description: Johner reacts angrily to the news, calling Earth a 'fucking slum' and declaring he does not want to go there.

entities.name: Call realizes the catastrophic risk of aliens reaching Earth
entities.description: Call becomes distressed upon understanding that if the aliens reach Earth, the consequences will be devastating.

entities.name: Ripley states the potential outcome as 'the end'
entities.description: Ripley calmly acknowledges that the aliens reaching Earth would mean the end of humanity, showing little emotional reaction.

entities.name: St. Just dismisses Earth's fate as irrelevant
entities.description: St. Just declares that the potential destruction of Earth is not their concern, showing indifference to the larger consequences.

entities.name: Call proposes destroying the ship to prevent Earth's contamination
entities.description: Call insists that they must destroy the ship before it reaches Earth to stop the alien threat.

entities.name: Christie prioritizes immediate survival over long-term consequences
entities.description: Christie argues that their only concern should be surviving until they can escape, rejecting Call's urgency to destroy the ship.

entities.name: Call calculates arrival time to Earth
entities.description: Call determines that the ship will reach Earth in nearly three hours, providing a timeline for decision-making.

entities.name: Christie sets group movement into motion
entities.description: After confirming they have almost three hours, Christie decides it is time to move and organizes the group to proceed.

entities.name: Christie assigns Ripley to take point position
entities.description: Christie asks Ripley to lead the group as they begin moving, establishing her role at the front of the formation.

entities.name: Group begins moving in formation
entities.description: Following Christie's order and Ripley taking point, the group starts advancing together through the ship.

A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

document_metadata.title: 22、INT..NEXT CHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Purvis learns an alien is inside him, implanted by Wren; Ripley reveals the truth, Call insists on saving him by freezing, and the group evacuates together despite tension.

entities.name: Purvis attacks Ripley with a metal bar in panic
entities.description: Purvis, disoriented and terrified upon waking, swings a metal bar at Ripley and strikes her side, causing her to lose balance before being subdued by the crew.

entities.name: Crew confronts Purvis and demands he drop the weapon
entities.description: St Just and Christie raise their weapons and order Purvis to drop the metal bar, with the rest of the crew rushing in to contain the situation as he collapses in confusion.

entities.name: Ripley detects an alien organism inside Purvis
entities.description: Ripley sniffs the air, senses something wrong, and declares that Purvis is carrying an alien creature inside him, prompting alarm among the crew.

entities.name: Crew debates whether to save or execute Purvis
entities.description: The crew argues over Purvis's fate, with St Just suggesting a painless execution, Call advocating for freezing him, and Wren confirming no medical intervention is possible on board.

entities.name: ghost ship
entities.description: A derelict spacecraft where the current events are taking place, referred to colloquially as a 'ghost ship'.

entities.name: cryo
entities.description: A state of cryogenic suspension used for transporting crew members like Purvis to distant locations.

entities.name: Xarem
entities.description: A destination planet or facility where Purvis was originally headed for work at a nickel refinery.
entities.summary: A destination planet or facility where Purvis was originally headed for work at a nickel refinery.

entities.name: Nickel Refinery
entities.description: An industrial facility on Xarem where Purvis was assigned to work as part of a crew.
entities.summary: An industrial facility on Xarem where Purvis was assigned to work as part of a crew.

entities.name: corner
entities.description: A specific area within the immediate environment where Purvis is cowering after attacking Ripley.

entities.name: coveralls
entities.description: The garment worn by Purvis, bearing his name stitched on it, indicating his role or affiliation.

entities.name: lab
entities.description: A scientific facility aboard the ship, now damaged, where medical or biological procedures could be performed.

entities.name: Purvis
entities.description: A crew member who awakens from cryo in a state of panic and is later discovered to be carrying an alien organism inside him.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens panicked with an alien inside; the group travels through a tunnel, anxious and exhausted, while another saves Johner by shooting an alien, and later urges Call to flee, stressing the need for a quick death for Ripley.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A key crew member with heightened senses who detects the presence of an alien organism within Purvis.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member advocating for saving Purvis and opposing immediate execution, showing concern for ethical decisions.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: St Just
entities.description: A pragmatic crew member who identifies Purvis by his coveralls and suggests euthanizing him to prevent risk.
entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A crew member who reacts quickly to threats and demands Purvis drop the weapon during the confrontation.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member expressing fear about the alien organism and opposing the idea of keeping Purvis alive.
entities.summary: A volatile individual threatens Little Annalee, while crew members express fear, frustration, and confusion about being locked in and the alien organism, opposing keeping Purvis alive.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A crew member who emphasizes the danger Purvis poses and supports preventing the spread of the alien organisms.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A medical or scientific authority figure among the crew who states that extraction of the organism is impossible in the current conditions.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: metal bar
entities.description: A weapon used by Purvis in panic to defend himself against the crew, later dropped when he collapses.

entities.name: work crew
entities.description: A group of laborers assigned to work at the nickel refinery on Xarem, of which Purvis was a member.

entities.name: Ripley reveals the alien organism inside Purvis to the crew
entities.description: Ripley interrupts Doctor Wren and directly informs Purvis that there is a monster in his stomach, explaining that the smugglers hijacked his cryotube and sold him to Wren, who implanted the alien; she also states that the creature will burst from his chest within hours, killing him.

entities.name: Call asserts leadership and proposes freezing Purvis for medical treatment
entities.description: Call declares that Purvis must come with them, suggesting they freeze him aboard the Betty so a doctor can later remove the alien organism, thereby taking command of the situation.

entities.name: Johnner challenges Call's authority
entities.description: Johnner questions Call's sudden assumption of leadership by sarcastically asking since when she is in charge, expressing resistance to her decision.

entities.name: Call retorts to Johnner's challenge with a personal insult
entities.description: In response to Johnner's defiance, Call mocks him by saying he was born without courage, escalating the tension between them.

entities.name: Vriess intervenes to defuse conflict within the group
entities.description: Vriess tells the arguing members to ease off, acting as a mediator to reduce rising hostilities among the crew during a tense moment.

entities.name: Christie escorts Purvis under threat of violence
entities.description: Christie directs Purvis to follow the group, warning him that he might survive if compliant, but will be shot if he becomes aggressive or uncooperative.

entities.name: Group moves cautiously through the hall sensing danger
entities.description: The crew advances through a hallway in a state of heightened alert, scanning every corner due to an unnerving silence that suggests potential threat presence.

entities.name: later
entities.description: A relative temporal anchor indicating a short time after a previous event in the same scene.

entities.name: hall
entities.description: A physical interior corridor where the group moves cautiously, sensing danger.

entities.name: Cryotube
entities.description: A life-support pod used for transporting humans in stasis, which was hijacked and used to smuggle Purvis with an implanted alien.
entities.summary: A life-support pod used for transporting humans in stasis, which was hijacked and used to smuggle Purvis with an implanted alien.

entities.name: smugglers
entities.description: A group of individuals who hijacked Purvis's cryotube and trafficked him for illegal purposes involving alien implantation.

entities.name: Alien
entities.description: A parasitic extraterrestrial organism implanted in Purvis that will eventually kill him by emerging from his chest.
entities.summary: Parasitic extraterrestrial organisms implanted in hosts, growing rapidly and emerging violently from their chests, resulting in host death; one such creature attacks the crew during escape.
