document_metadata.title: 23、INT. OBSERVATION ROOM TWO - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group nears their destination; Call restores her voice, Purvis expresses fatigue, Johner makes a grim remark, Ripley counters his fatalism as they proceed through the tunnel.

entities.name: Johner fires at aliens during underwater escape
entities.description: As the crew swims through the flooded kitchen, Johner notices three aliens behind him, panics, and opens fire, hitting one before the others disappear into the shadows.

entities.name: Alien attacks Rane during underwater swim
entities.description: While the crew is swimming toward safety, alien hands emerge from the darkness, grab Rane, and pull him into the shadows.

entities.name: Hillard fires toward alien that attacked Rane
entities.description: After Rane is grabbed by an alien, Hillard shoots in the direction of the attack in an attempt to defend him.

entities.name: Crew dives into black water to escape
entities.description: Following a countdown, the entire crew takes deep breaths and dives into dark, submerged water to navigate through a flooded area.

entities.name: Ripley urges crew to move past her toward safety
entities.description: Upon seeing Johner attacked by aliens, Ripley quickens the pace and helps push the remaining crew members ahead of her through the underwater passage.

entities.name: Crew swims through flooded stairwell and kitchen
entities.description: The crew moves swiftly and carefully through a dark, partially submerged, maze-like environment, navigating from the stairwell into the kitchen area.

entities.name: Vriess requests Christie to avoid backstroke after surfacing
entities.description: Before diving, Vriess jokingly asks Christie not to use backstroke when they emerge on the other side, referencing the danger of bubbles alerting enemies.

entities.name: Call initiates dive countdown
entities.description: Call prompts the crew to take a deep breath and begins a countdown before they all submerge into the water.

entities.name: stairwell\kitchen
entities.description: A flooded interior space combining a stairwell and kitchen, serving as a passage for the crew's underwater escape.

entities.name: continuous
entities.description: Indicates the scene follows immediately from the previous action without temporal gap.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who becomes panicked during the underwater escape and fires at pursuing aliens.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Rane
entities.description: A crew member who is attacked by alien hands during the underwater swim through the flooded stairwell and kitchen.
entities.summary: A quiet crew member aboard the Auriga, involved in the night cycle and security chaos, is questioned about mobility, survives initial encounters, and later expresses concern about alien creatures, suggesting military backup before being killed in a firefight.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A crew member who fires toward the alien attacking Rane during the underwater escape.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A central crew member who urges others to move past her toward safety during the underwater escape.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A crew member who requests Christie to avoid backstroke after surfacing during the dive.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member who initiates the dive countdown and leads the group into the black water.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A crew member who responds to Vriess's request with a joke about bubbles before diving.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A crew member who leads the way through the flooded kitchen toward safety.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Di Stephano
entities.description: A crew member who reacts uneasily to a conversation about disposable weapons before preparing to dive.
entities.summary: A crew member shows discomfort discussing disposable weapons, nearly drowns during an underwater attack but is revived by Ripley, and later helps direct evacuation efforts, assisting Vriess down the staircase.

entities.name: St Just
entities.description: A crew member who comments on the practicality of using disposable weapons during a mission.
entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: weapon
entities.description: A firearm discussed as being disposable after use, indicating its role in the crew's tactical planning.

entities.name: Crew
entities.description: The group of individuals escaping together through the flooded environment, working as a unit under pressure.
entities.summary: A group of human survivors, including Ripley, Call, St Just, Hillard, and Johner, work together aboard a vessel and through a flooded facility to escape alien threats while facing moral dilemmas and intense pressure.

entities.name: black water
entities.description: The dark, submerged environment through which the crew dives to escape, limiting visibility and increasing danger.

entities.name: underwater escape
entities.description: The coordinated effort by the crew to flee through flooded areas, relying on breath-holding and stealth.

entities.name: Call becomes trapped in alien web below water surface
entities.description: As Call swims toward the surface, she becomes ensnared in a net of translucent alien goo just below the surface, struggles to free herself, and begins running out of air.

entities.name: Wren and Christie encounter alien web and struggle to escape
entities.description: Wren and Christie reach the water surface but are caught in the same alien web as Call, struggling to break free while weakening from lack of oxygen.

entities.name: Alien grabs Ripley's foot during underwater escape
entities.description: As Ripley swims upward during the escape, an alien grabs her foot and holds her down, forcing her to kick free while running out of air.

entities.name: Call cuts through alien web with stiletto
entities.description: Trapped in the alien web, Call activates her stiletto and cuts an opening, attempting to reach the surface despite the web's resistance.

entities.name: Di Stephano drowns while trapped in alien web
entities.description: Di Stephano, caught in the alien web and unable to surface, inhales a large amount of water and begins thrashing before succumbing to drowning.

entities.name: Ripley tears open alien web to create escape path
entities.description: After freeing herself, Ripley returns underwater and uses strength to widen the hole Call cut in the web, allowing others to surface.

entities.name: Ripley surfaces and is attacked by facehugger
entities.description: Immediately after breaking the surface and gasping for air, Ripley is ambushed by a facehugger that clamps onto her face, pulling her back underwater.

entities.name: Call shoots facehugger leaping at Wren
entities.description: As Wren surfaces, a facehugger jumps toward him, but Call quickly fires four shots, killing the creature before it can attach.

entities.name: Christie and Vriess surface and destroy alien eggs
entities.description: After breaking the surface, Christie and Vriess begin firing in a circular pattern, back to back, destroying multiple alien eggs in their vicinity.

entities.name: staircase
entities.description: An interior structure within the submerged environment where Call swims upward toward the surface.

entities.name: surface
entities.description: The upper boundary of the water where characters emerge from the underwater escape, marked by growing light and air access.

entities.name: alien web
entities.description: A net-like structure made of translucent alien goo spread just below the water surface, trapping escaping characters.

entities.name: Stiletto
entities.description: A small blade that Call uses to cut through the alien web just below the surface of the water.
entities.summary:
A concealed, foot-long bladed weapon that extends from Call's sleeve and is intended for assassinating Ripley.
A small blade that Call uses to cut through the alien web just below the surface of the water.

entities.name: Facehugger
entities.description: A parasitic alien creature that attacks Ripley and attempts to attach itself to Wren, capable of leaping and clamping onto faces.
entities.summary:
A parasitic alien creature that attacks Ripley and attempts to attach itself to Wren, capable of leaping and clamping onto faces.
A parasitic alien creature that attaches to hosts' faces and attempts to implant embryos, posing a direct biological threat to the crew.

entities.description: Egg-like structures present near the surface that Christie and Vriess destroy after surfacing.

document_metadata.title: 23、INT. OBSERVATION ROOM TWO - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group nears their destination; Call restores her voice, Purvis expresses fatigue, Johner makes a grim remark, Ripley counters his fatalism as they proceed through the tunnel.

entities.name: Ripley forcibly removes facehugger from her throat
entities.description: Underwater, Ripley pulls a facehugger off herself with great effort, its fingers burning her face and its fleshy appendage tearing from her throat, leaving injuries.

entities.name: Ripley tears facehugger apart in disgust
entities.description: After removing the facehugger, Ripley rips it apart with her hands, reacting to its invasive and horrifying presence.

entities.name: Aliens attack Ripley and crew underwater
entities.description: Immediately after Ripley removes the facehugger, three aliens advance toward her and the crew while they are still in the water.

entities.name: Christie holds facehugger near his face and calls for help
entities.description: Above the water, Christie is seen holding a live facehugger close to his face while shouting for someone to kill it before it attacks.

entities.name: Johner shoots facehugger in midair
entities.description: After Christie throws the facehugger, Johner successfully shoots it mid-flight, preventing it from latching onto anyone.

entities.name: Hillard and Johner rescue Di Stephano from water
entities.description: Hillard and Johner pull Di Stephano out of the water, where he is found unconscious and not breathing.

entities.name: St Just shoots alien attacking Ripley underwater
entities.description: An alien grabs Ripley beneath the surface, but St Just arrives and shoots the creature, saving her.

entities.name: Ripley and St Just escape underwater blood pool
entities.description: After killing the alien, Ripley and St Just swim upward and away from the expanding pool of lethal alien blood.

entities.name: Crew shoots alien emerging from water
entities.description: As an alien surfaces behind Ripley and St Just, the surviving crew members open fire, forcing it back into the water.

entities.name: Christie realizes the aliens set an ambush
entities.description: Christie shouts that the alien attack was a deliberate trap, indicating the creatures had planned an ambush.

entities.name: Johner retrieves and fires plasma burner into water
entities.description: Johner takes a plasma burner from Di Stephano’s body and fires it into the water, electrifying it and causing an alien to wail in pain.

entities.name: Johner declares pool area unsafe
entities.description: After electrifying the water, Johner shouts for everyone to get out of the pool area immediately.

entities.name: Di Stephano revives after near-drowning
entities.description: After being pulled from the water and receiving mouth-to-mouth from Call, Di Stephano begins breathing again and sputters back to life.

entities.name: Ripley carries Di Stephano after rescue
entities.description: Ripley lifts Di Stephano off the ground with one hand, supporting him as the group prepares to flee.

entities.name: Wren directs group toward lift shaft
entities.description: Wren leads the surviving crew members toward a lift shaft, instructing them to escape through it.

entities.name: Ripley forces open lift shaft doors
entities.description: Ripley reaches the sliding doors of the lift shaft and pulls them apart manually with physical effort.

entities.name: St Just warns of approaching aliens
entities.description: St Just alerts the group to the presence of incoming aliens by shouting 'Company!', referring to their advancing shadows and sounds.

entities.name: Ripley herds survivors into lift shaft
entities.description: After opening the doors, Ripley ensures all remaining crew members enter the lift shaft for escape.

entities.name: underwater
entities.description: A submerged area within a body of water where Ripley confronts the facehugger and is attacked by an alien.

entities.name: above the surface
entities.description: The area above the water where most of the crew has emerged and where Christie holds the facehugger.

entities.name: bloodpool
entities.description: A spreading pool of lethal alien blood in the water from which Ripley and St Just escape.

entities.name: lift shaft
entities.description: A vertical passage accessed through sliding doors, used by the group to escape the approaching aliens.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A central crew member who actively fights against the alien threat, rescues others, and demonstrates physical strength and leadership in crisis situations.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A crew member who panics while holding a facehugger near his face and calls for help, contributing to the group's awareness of the alien ambush.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who shoots a facehugger midair, retrieves a plasma burner, and fires it into the water to kill an alien, showing aggressive initiative in combat.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A crew member involved in rescuing Di Stephano from the water and later asking for direction during escape.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: Di Stephano
entities.description: A crew member who nearly drowns during the underwater attack, is revived, and is carried to safety by Ripley.
entities.summary: A crew member shows discomfort discussing disposable weapons, nearly drowns during an underwater attack but is revived by Ripley, and later helps direct evacuation efforts, assisting Vriess down the staircase.

entities.name: St Just
entities.description: A crew member who saves Ripley by shooting an attacking alien underwater and later warns the group of approaching aliens.
entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: Wren
entities.description: A crew member who directs the group toward the lift shaft and leads the escape route.
entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member who performs mouth-to-mouth resuscitation on Di Stephano after his rescue from the water.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A crew member who expresses urgency to leave the area after the alien threat is neutralized in the pool.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: Facehugger
entities.description: A parasitic alien creature that attaches to hosts' faces and attempts to implant embryos, posing a direct biological threat to the crew.
entities.summary:
A parasitic alien creature that attacks Ripley and attempts to attach itself to Wren, capable of leaping and clamping onto faces.
A parasitic alien creature that attaches to hosts' faces and attempts to implant embryos, posing a direct biological threat to the crew.

entities.name: Plasma Burner
entities.description: A weapon retrieved from Di Stephano's body and used by Johner to fire into the water, causing an alien to wail in pain.
entities.summary: A weapon retrieved from Di Stephano's body and used by Johner to fire into the water, causing an alien to wail in pain.

entities.name: sliding doors
entities.description: Mechanical doors at the lift shaft entrance that Wren attempts to open before Ripley forces them apart.

entities.name: Crew
entities.description: The collective group of human survivors aboard the vessel who respond to the alien attack and attempt to escape together.
entities.summary: A group of human survivors, including Ripley, Call, St Just, Hillard, and Johner, work together aboard a vessel and through a flooded facility to escape alien threats while facing moral dilemmas and intense pressure.

entities.name: alien ambush
entities.description: A coordinated attack strategy employed by the aliens, demonstrated by their sudden breach of the lift shaft door.

entities.name: Wren begins climbing ladder in lift shaft
entities.description: Wren starts ascending the lift shaft using the ladders mounted on the shaft walls, initiating the group's vertical escape.

entities.name: Call climbs up behind Wren in lift shaft
entities.description: Call follows Wren up the ladder in the lift shaft, positioning herself directly behind him during the ascent.

entities.name: Ripley and others ascend separate ladders in lift shaft
entities.description: Ripley and the remaining crew members begin climbing their own ladders in the lift shaft, spreading across the available climbing routes.

entities.name: Aliens pound on lift shaft door and begin breaking through
entities.description: The aliens violently attack the metal door at the base of the lift shaft, causing it to buckle under their force.

entities.name: Alien inserts head through broken lift shaft door and hisses
entities.description: One alien forces its head through the compromised door, looks upward at the escaping humans, and emits a threatening hiss before retreating.

entities.name: Aliens smash through lift shaft door and begin climbing
entities.description: The aliens fully breach the lift shaft door, with one launching across the shaft to grab a pipe, enabling rapid ascent by multiple aliens.

entities.name: Facehugger crawls on adult alien's head during ascent
entities.description: As one adult alien climbs the shaft, a facehugger moves erratically across its head, resembling a frightened spider.

entities.name: Wren reaches crawl space ledge and attempts to open maintenance door
entities.description: Wren arrives at a ledge near a maintenance access door and begins working the keypad to gain entry.

entities.name: Call hands gun to Wren at maintenance door
entities.description: Call passes her firearm to Wren to assist him in forcing entry through the jammed maintenance access door.

entities.name: Wren shoots Call through the chest at maintenance door
entities.description: Without hesitation, Wren uses Call's gun to shoot her in the chest, causing her to fall backward.

entities.name: Call falls down lift shaft and lands on elevator
entities.description: After being shot, Call falls six stories down the lift shaft and impacts an elevator car below, dying instantly.

entities.name: Vriess reacts to Call's death and fires at Wren
entities.description: Vriess shouts in anguish upon witnessing Call's death and opens fire toward Wren in retaliation.

entities.name: Wren enters maintenance access door after unlocking it
entities.description: Wren successfully inputs the code, the door opens, and he slips through into the maintenance area before it closes.

entities.name: Ripley leaps and grabs crawl space ledge
entities.description: Ripley jumps across the shaft to seize the ledge just as Wren enters, pulling herself up to safety.

entities.name: Ripley is locked out as maintenance door closes and locks
entities.description: The maintenance door shuts in front of Ripley, its lock indicator turning red, sealing her out of the access area.

entities.name: Ripley slams against closed maintenance door in frustration
entities.description: Trapped outside, Ripley pounds on the sealed door in a futile attempt to reopen it.

entities.name: Liftshaft
entities.description: A vertical shaft containing ladders and elevators, serving as the immediate setting for the climbing and escape sequence.

entities.name: Continuous
entities.description: Indicates the scene follows immediately from the previous action without temporal gap.

entities.name: gun
entities.description: A firearm handed by Call to Wren, which Wren immediately uses to shoot Call.

entities.name: maintenance access door
entities.description: A secured door set back from the crawl space ledge in the lift shaft, accessed via a keypad.

entities.name: keypad
entities.description: An electronic input device beside the maintenance access door used to enter an access code.

entities.name: ladders
entities.description: Metal ladders installed in each section of the lift shaft, used by the crew to climb quickly upward.

document_metadata.title: 23、INT. OBSERVATION ROOM TWO - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group nears their destination; Call restores her voice, Purvis expresses fatigue, Johner makes a grim remark, Ripley counters his fatalism as they proceed through the tunnel.

entities.name: St Just hangs upside down and shoots nearby alien
entities.description: St Just releases the ladder, hangs inverted with his knees hooked over a rung, draws his weapons, and fires, destroying several holes in the closest alien.

entities.name: Alien emerges near Ripley causing her to attack and fall
entities.description: An alien rises over the ledge within three feet of Ripley, prompting her to scream, hurl herself at it, and both go flying off into space before crashing into the opposite wall and falling.

entities.name: Ripley grabs pole during fall and survives
entities.description: While falling after colliding with the alien, Ripley manages to grab a pole, enduring severe strain that nearly dislocates her arm, but she holds on while the alien plummets to its death.

entities.name: Facehugger attaches to Call's face and detaches upon detecting no breath
entities.description: A facehugger latches onto Call's face, pauses, then slightly pulls back to probe his nostrils with two digits, senses no respiration, and scurries away in search of a viable host.

entities.name: Alien attacks Christie while Vriess tries to reload
entities.description: An alien rapidly approaches Christie and Vriess; as Vriess struggles to reload, he shouts a warning, Christie turns and aims, but the alien closes in, grabs Christie, and sprays him with blood.

entities.name: Christie fires again and repels attacking alien
entities.description: While being held by the alien and hanging from the ladder, Christie fires a second shot, causing the alien to be blasted off and fall down the shaft.

entities.name: Hillard urges group to move as last alien retreats
entities.description: Hillard declares they must leave immediately as the final alien abruptly turns and scurries back down the shaft after its counterparts.

entities.name: Ripley declares they are locked in and must climb
entities.description: Ripley announces the group is trapped due to locked doors, and upon learning the next exit is far, decides they must climb to reach safety.

entities.name: Group begins rapid ascent with injured Christie
entities.description: The group starts climbing quickly, with Vriess carrying the wounded Christie on his back, ascending at remarkable speed despite the physical burden.

entities.name: Vriess encourages Christie during climb
entities.description: While climbing with Christie on his back, Vriess reassures him by saying he just needs to hang on and that he will get them both to safety.

entities.name: ladder
entities.description: A vertical climbing structure used by the group to ascend, serving as the primary setting for the escape sequence.

entities.name: shaft
entities.description: An enclosed vertical space through which the alien falls and the group climbs, indicating the structural context of the scene.

entities.name: wall on the other side
entities.description: The opposing surface in the shaft where Ripley and the alien collide after being thrown backward.

entities.name: ledge
entities.description: A narrow projection or edge near Ripley from which an alien emerges, marking a specific point of threat in the environment.

entities.name: moments later
entities.description: A short, relative temporal marker indicating the rapid succession of events following the initial alien attack.

entities.name: St Just
entities.description: A member of the group who hangs upside down from the ladder to shoot an approaching alien.
entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A central figure in the group who reacts to a sudden alien attack by fighting it and falling, then survives by grabbing a pole.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A character who remains motionless as a facehugger investigates her face but leaves upon detecting no breath.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Christie
entities.description: A member of the group who is attacked by an alien and injured during the climb.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens when addressed by Elgyn, participates in a poker game with Johner, Call, and St Just, observes a doublecross, and later attacks Ripley after she assaults Johner.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A member of the group who supports Christie during the climb and attempts to reload under pressure.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A member of the group who urges the others to move as the last alien retreats.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A member of the group who reacts with frustration upon learning they are locked in.
entities.summary: A volatile individual threatens Little Annalee, while crew members express fear, frustration, and confusion about being locked in and the alien organism, opposing keeping Purvis alive.

entities.name: Purvis
entities.description: A member of the group who asks how far it is to the next door.
entities.summary: A crew member awakens panicked with an alien inside; the group travels through a tunnel, anxious and exhausted, while another saves Johner by shooting an alien, and later urges Call to flee, stressing the need for a quick death for Ripley.

entities.name: Di Stephano
entities.description: A member of the group who responds that the next door is far away.
entities.summary: A group including soldiers, crew, and guards attempts to evacuate Wren amid system restrictions, using alternate escape routes while confirming autopilot protocols and advancing cautiously downward.

entities.name: pole
entities.description: A vertical metal rod that Ripley grabs during her fall, allowing her to survive.

entities.name: guns
entities.description: Firearms used by St Just to shoot the approaching alien.

entities.name: facehugger
entities.description: A parasitic alien creature that attempts to attach to Call's face but retreats upon detecting no breath.

entities.name: Aliens
entities.description: Hostile extraterrestrial creatures attacking the group during their ascent.
entities.summary:
Hostile extraterrestrial creatures attacking the group during their ascent.
Hostile extraterrestrial entities attacking the crew and breaching the ship's hull.
Hostile extraterrestrial entities attempting to breach the platform through the metal door.

entities.name: Johner checks Christie's pulse and confirms his death
entities.description: Johner examines Christie's neck for a pulse and informs Vriess that Christie is dead, marking a moment of grim realization during the group's ascent.

entities.name: Hillard cuts the cord connecting Vriess and Christie
entities.description: Seeing that Christie is dead and slowing their escape, Hillard silently decides to sever the cord binding him to Vriess, causing Christie's body to fall into the shaft.

entities.name: Christie's body falls into the shaft after cord is cut
entities.description: After Hillard cuts the cord, Christie's lifeless body drops down the dark shaft, met with silence from the group above.

entities.name: Two Aliens emerge in the shaft below the group
entities.description: Shortly after Christie's body falls, two Aliens are seen climbing up the shaft beneath the survivors, signaling renewed danger.

entities.name: Purvis alerts group to approaching Aliens
entities.description: Purvis notices the Aliens climbing up the shaft and exclaims 'Company!', warning the others of the immediate threat.

entities.name: Hillard asks how much further to the top of the shaft
entities.description: As the Aliens close in, Hillard looks upward and urgently asks how much farther remains in the climb.

entities.name: Johner urges group to keep climbing despite distance
entities.description: Responding to Hillard's question, Johner acknowledges the distance is too great but insists they continue climbing immediately to escape the Aliens.

entities.name: Aliens rapidly ascend the shaft and gain on the group
entities.description: The Aliens begin climbing much faster than the humans, quickly closing the distance and increasing the urgency of the escape.

entities.name: Loud clacking sound echoes from bottom of shaft
entities.description: A distinct and ominous clacking noise rises from the depths of the shaft, drawing the attention of some group members who look down in fear.

entities.name: the minutes stretching out
entities.description: A relative temporal expression indicating the passage of time during the climb, emphasizing the prolonged effort and lack of progress.

entities.name: the shaft
entities.description: A physical vertical passage where the group is climbing and where Christie's body falls, serving as the primary setting for the scene's action.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A member of the group climbing the shaft who interacts with Ripley and checks Christie's pulse.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.description: A knife used by Hillard to cut the cord connecting Vriess and Christie.

document_metadata.summary: The group nears their destination; Call restores her voice, Purvis expresses fatigue, Johner makes a grim remark, Ripley counters his fatalism as they proceed through the tunnel.

entities.name: Lift ascends rapidly past aliens in the shaft
entities.description: The elevator suddenly moves upward at high speed, passing the aliens who are climbing in the shaft, surprising the crew.

entities.name: Call emerges from the lift hatch unharmed
entities.description: Call appears through the hatch of the stopped lift, alive and unexpectedly intact despite prior assumptions of her death.

entities.description: Ripley notices the approaching door and shouts for the lift to stop, allowing access to the corridor.

entities.name: Ripley pries open lift doors and crew escapes
entities.description: After the lift stops, Ripley forces the doors open, enabling the crew to exit into the hallway.

entities.name: Ripley rescues Call from alien's grasp
entities.description: As an alien grabs Call's ankle during escape, Ripley pulls her free, wrenching her away from the creature.

entities.name: Ripley destroys lift with shotgun to eliminate aliens
entities.description: Ripley takes Hillard's shotgun and fires at the lift's support cables, causing it to plummet and crush both aliens at the bottom of the shaft.

entities.name: shaft

entities.name: lift

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A central crew member who takes decisive action during the alien threat, including stopping the lift, rescuing Call, and destroying the lift to eliminate the aliens.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member who emerges unharmed from the lift, operates its controls, sustains a chest wound, and is rescued by Ripley from an alien's grasp.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: St Just
entities.description: A crew member who shoots an alien approaching the lift from the shaft.
entities.summary: A calm, slim Asian man assists in docking, uses a forearm device, comments on the ship's cleanliness, participates in a poker game, and later stands silently in the mess hall, possibly hiding something.

entities.name: Hillard
entities.description: A crew member who questions Call about the whereabouts of the other survivors.
entities.summary: A roughskinned woman in her forties pilots the ship to Auriga, shares a close bond with Elgyn, disdains the military, participates in a confrontation where she incapacitates a guard, and is seen in a luxurious sleep chamber during the night cycle.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who expresses frustration and disbelief about the aliens' ability to operate elevators, directing his question at Ripley.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.name: shotgun
entities.description: A firearm used by Hillard and later taken by Ripley to destroy the lift and kill the aliens.

entities.name: emergency brake
entities.description: A control mechanism in the lift used to stop its movement, operated by Call and referenced during the crew's escape.

entities.name: jacket
entities.description: Clothing worn by Call to conceal her chest wound while operating the lift.

entities.name: Crew
entities.description: The group of survivors and ship personnel working together to escape the alien threat, including Ripley, Call, St Just, Hillard, and Johner.
entities.summary: A group of human survivors, including Ripley, Call, St Just, Hillard, and Johner, work together aboard a vessel and through a flooded facility to escape alien threats while facing moral dilemmas and intense pressure.

entities.description: Vriess tells Call he is glad to see her, believing she might have been killed by the alien, and asks if she is injured.

entities.description: Call reassures the crew she is fine and confirms she is wearing body armour when questioned.

entities.description: Ripley challenges Call's claim of being unharmed, stating she saw her get shot, showing suspicion.

entities.description: Ripley spins Call around and notices a trickle of fluid from her nose and a mechanical wound on her chest, revealing she is a synthetic being.

entities.description: Johner exclaims in disbelief that Call is a synthetic, expressing outrage and surprise.

entities.name: Hillard comments on Call's hidden nature
entities.description: Hillard reacts to the revelation by calling Call a 'son of a bitch' and remarking on how full of surprises she is.

entities.name: Ripley reflects on Call's zealous humanity claims
entities.description: Ripley quietly admits she should have realized Call was synthetic, comparing her fervent claims of humanity to a 'Born Again' zealot.

entities.name: St Just questions Ripley's inability to detect synthetic
entities.description: St Just sarcastically asks Ripley if she couldn't smell out that Call was a synthetic, referencing her past experience with such beings.

entities.description: Vriess tells Ripley that the LM7 model was intended to revitalize the synthetic industry but instead led to its downfall.

entities.summary: An authority figure reviews Ripley's medical data, while scientists study her cognitive responses and propose genetic collective memory theories. A military representative discusses the alien species' potential uses, and a team member assesses mutation risks, with another activating cryotube procedures involving alien eggs.

document_metadata.title: 23、INT. OBSERVATION ROOM TWO - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group nears their destination; Call restores her voice, Purvis expresses fatigue, Johner makes a grim remark, Ripley counters his fatalism as they proceed through the tunnel.

entities.name: Call activates her forearm interface to connect with Ripley's cable
entities.description: Call reveals a hidden panel in her forearm by pressing below her elbow, which releases a spring-loaded cover exposing two computer ports; she then inserts a cable provided by Ripley, initiating a data or power transfer.

entities.name: Call reconfigures internal components in her chest to restore function
entities.description: After experiencing a failure in her systems, Call reaches into her chest cavity to reconnect internal tubes, causing a physical twitch followed by eye closure as she initiates a diagnostic or reboot sequence.

entities.name: Call reports critical system breach and engine status during docking countdown
entities.description: With eyes closed and voice taking on a mechanical tone, Call rapidly relays information about sector breaches, unstable systems, engine efficiency at 86 percent, and a remaining time of 46 minutes until Earth docking.

entities.name: Call determines she cannot achieve critical mass due to energy depletion
entities.description: After assessing her systems, Call announces that excessive energy consumption has prevented her from reaching critical mass, rendering her unable to trigger a destructive explosion.

entities.name: Ripley instructs Call to crash the vessel as an alternative to detonation
entities.description: Upon learning that Call cannot initiate a self-destruct, Ripley commands her to deliberately crash the ship instead, suggesting a shift in tactical approach to neutralize the threat.

entities.name: Call recalibrates ground level coordinates to new destination
entities.description: Call updates the navigation system, setting a new target location at coordinates 760, 403, and confirms the change has been implemented with 41 minutes remaining until impact.

entities.name: Call detects unauthorized nonhuman presence in waste tank 5
entities.description: Using partial visual feed from a malfunctioning surveillance system, Call identifies an intruder in sublevel waste tank 5 and classifies it as nonhuman, triggering an alert.

entities.name: Call uses emergency override with handprint ID to identify intruder as Wren
entities.description: Call accesses console 45V on level one through an emergency override using her biometric handprint, confirming that the approaching figure near the Betty is Wren.

entities.name: Ripley questions Call's emotional response to Wren's approach
entities.description: After learning that Wren is nearing the Betty, Ripley asks Call how she feels about his presence, introducing a moment of psychological or emotional evaluation.

document_metadata.title: 23、INT. OBSERVATION ROOM TWO - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The group nears their destination; Call restores her voice, Purvis expresses fatigue, Johner makes a grim remark, Ripley counters his fatalism as they proceed through the tunnel.

entities.name: Call removes cord from her port and attempts to repair wiring
entities.description: Call disconnects a cord from her port and manually manipulates wires in her chest to fix a malfunction in her voice system, showing signs of distress and mechanical failure.

entities.name: Ripley comments on Call's deteriorating condition with dark humor
entities.description: Ripley observes Call's malfunction and responds with unsettling laughter, expressing confusion about what she finds funny and acknowledging a distorted sense of humor.

entities.name: Call confronts Ripley about her reasons for continuing to live
entities.description: Call questions Ripley's motivation for survival, expressing despair over her own existence and self-perception as disgusting due to her mechanical nature.

entities.name: Ripley reflects on the horror of her dreams and waking reality
entities.description: Ripley reveals that she dreams nightly about the aliens, describing how the nightmares are less terrible than the reality she faces upon waking.

entities.description: Call confirms that she experiences dream-like states via her neural processors, indicating a convergence of artificial cognition and emotional experience.

entities.description: A synthetic being with neural processors and a physical port, capable of experiencing mechanical failures and emotional distress, who questions her own humanity and existence.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A human survivor haunted by traumatic dreams involving the alien creatures, who maintains a darkly humorous and resigned perspective on suffering and survival.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.summary: Internal technology in Call that enables cognitive functions and dream-like simulations, indicating her synthetic consciousness.

document_metadata.summary: The jeep plummets down a terraced slope, aliens pursue; Ripley swerves onto steps, then takes a left into a corridor as the crew fires at the creatures.

entities.name: Crew discovers cannabis field in ship's garden
entities.description: While traveling through the ship's large agricultural garden in a platform jeep, the crew arrives at a section overgrown with ten-foot-high cannabis plants, prompting reactions of disbelief and amusement.

entities.name: Ripley drives crew through agricultural garden

entities.name: Crew boards platform jeep in garden

entities.name: ship's agricultural garden

entities.name: waste tanks

entities.name: Call

entities.name: Vriess

entities.name: Johnner

entities.name: Di Stephano

document_metadata.title: 27、INT. WASTE TANK 5 - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: Ripley discovers no eggs in the hive; Gediman reveals the Queen's self-impregnating biology while being drained by aliens. As the Queen convulses, Ripley vows escape. Meanwhile, the crew rushes to evacuate aboard the Betty.

entities.name: Aliens emerge from air vent and carry Ripley upward
entities.description: The aliens exit through an air vent located high on the chamber wall and immediately move upward, seizing Ripley and transporting her to the top of the dark, goo-encrusted chamber.

entities.name: Aliens begin cocooning Ripley with secreted resin
entities.description: The aliens surround Ripley at the top of the chamber and start secreting resin from their backs, spitting and glopping it onto her to form a web-like cocoon as she struggles weakly against them.

entities.name: Crew members rush through antechamber toward loading dock
entities.description: The surviving crew members move urgently through the antechamber on their way to the loading dock, with Call bringing up the rear and pausing to look back.

entities.name: Purvis urges Call to leave and assists her departure
entities.description: Purvis grabs Call's arm, convinces her to stop hesitating, and insists that the best thing they can do for Ripley is to ensure a swift escape, prompting her to finally move on with him.

entities.name: Aliens complete cocooning of Ripley and retreat
entities.description: The aliens finish encasing Ripley in resinous webbing, leaving her suspended upside down with her legs glued to the ceiling, before climbing away from her position.

entities.name: Ripley regains consciousness while suspended in cocoon
entities.description: Ripley slowly awakens fully while hanging at an angle from the ceiling, encased in resin, and gains her first clear view of the chamber and its surroundings.

entities.name: Aliens tend to the injured Queen in the chamber below
entities.description: Several aliens attend to the Queen lying immobilized at the bottom of the chamber, spinning resin around her and vomiting blood onto her swollen abdomen, simultaneously serving and restraining her.

entities.description: The Alien Queen's belly violently opens, spraying blood and silencing all noise; from the wound emerges a large, previously unseen white alien with spider-like forelegs, powerful haunches, red-veined skin, and retractable pincers.

document_metadata.title: 39、INT. THE BETTY
document_metadata.summary: Ripley escapes the dying harvester, rescues a terrified Call from alien blood, and drags her to safety as the newborn burns in flames, its skull collapsing as they cling together, covered in blood and debris.

entities.name: Call and Ripley retreat to the cockpit under pressure from the newborn
entities.description: As the newborn attacks the hatch, Call and Ripley move into the cockpit to escape immediate danger and prepare for emergency landing procedures.

entities.name: Vriess alerts crew about inability to perform vertical landing
entities.description: Vriess reports that the braking systems are damaged and a vertical setdown is impossible, escalating the urgency of the landing situation.

entities.name: Call assumes pilot controls to attempt emergency landing
entities.description: Call returns to the pilot's seat and takes control of the Betty, attempting to find a suitable landing zone despite the ship's compromised systems.

entities.name: The Betty makes uncontrolled touchdown on wooded terrain
entities.description: The ship descends rapidly, strikes a patch of land, bounces, and crashes through trees in a violent, uncontrolled landing sequence.

entities.name: Call activates thrusters to propel the Betty forward and dislodge the newborn
entities.description: In response to the newborn clinging to the ship, Call fires the thrusters, engulfing the creature in flame and forcing it to lose its grip.

entities.name: Vriess orders thrust termination during skid
entities.description: As the Betty careens out of control, Vriess commands Call to kill the thrust immediately to prevent further acceleration.

entities.name: The Betty skids across terrain and collides with wooded area
entities.description: After thrust termination, the ship continues to skid violently, throwing up debris and plowing through a dense forest before coming to a stop.

entities.name: Ripley is thrown into the windshield during crash
entities.description: The force of the crash hurls Ripley forward, causing her to impact the windshield, indicating the severity of the landing.

entities.name: Call checks crew status after crash
entities.description: Once the ship stops, Call removes her seatbelt and asks the crew if they are injured, initiating post-crash assessment.

entities.name: Newborn ambushes Call at the hatch
entities.description: As Call opens the hatch to exit, the newborn suddenly attacks, lunging at her with its piston-like tongue, narrowly missing her.

entities.name: Johner retrieves weapon during newborn attack
entities.description: Reacting to the newborn's assault on Call, Johner scrambles to get his gun to defend the crew.

entities.name: Ripley drags Call to safety from newborn attack
entities.description: After the newborn lunges, Ripley pulls Call away from the hatch to protect her from further danger.

entities.name: Vriess declares newborn is waiting outside the ship
entities.description: After the attack, Vriess warns the crew that the creature is not gone but is instead waiting for them to exit the ship.

entities.name: Call decides to pursue and destroy the newborn
entities.description: Recognizing the threat posed by the rapidly maturing creature, Call resolves to stop it before it can reach populated areas.

entities.name: Call and Ripley exchange determined look before confrontation
entities.description: Before exiting, Call and Ripley share a meaningful glance that conveys mutual understanding and resolve regarding the mission.

entities.name: Ripley determines newborn has left the immediate area
entities.description: Ripley assesses the situation and declares that the newborn is no longer nearby, contradicting Vriess's warning.

entities.name: Call arms herself with grenade launcher to hunt newborn
entities.description: Call retrieves a grenade launcher to use as a weapon against the newborn, preparing for a pursuit.

entities.name: Call tosses grenade launcher to Ripley for pursuit
entities.description: Recognizing Ripley's greater chance of success, Call gives her the grenade launcher as she prepares to chase the newborn.

entities.name: cockpit
entities.description: The interior control area of the Betty where Call and Ripley retreat and operate the ship's systems.

entities.name: hatch
entities.description: A door or opening on the ship through which the newborn attacks and Call exits.

entities.name: pilot's seat
entities.description: The designated seat in the cockpit where Call takes control of the ship during the emergency landing.

entities.name: vidscreen
entities.description: A display screen on the ship used by Johner to observe the newborn outside.

entities.name: rough, wooded terrain
entities.description: The forested and uneven ground where the Betty makes its uncontrolled touchdown.

entities.name: back of the ship
entities.description: The rear section of the Betty where the newborn moves to avoid debris during landing.

entities.name: thrusters
entities.description: Propulsion systems on the Betty used to dislodge the newborn and later shut down during skid.

entities.name: wooded area
entities.description: A densely forested region where the Betty collides and skids after touchdown.

entities.name: windshield
entities.description: The transparent front barrier of the cockpit into which Ripley is thrown during the crash.

entities.name: floor
entities.description: The interior ground surface of the ship where Call drops to avoid the newborn's tongue.

entities.name: thirty minutes old
entities.description: A temporal reference indicating the newborn's age, used to emphasize its rapid development.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description: A central character who survives the crash and assists in defending against the newborn creature.
entities.summary: A recovered individual recalls a dangerous creature; others exhibit trauma, physical changes, or are under study, including a clone with rapid recovery and a host with blue skin, while one is tested with picture cards showing disinterest.

entities.name: Call
entities.description: A crew member who takes control of the ship during emergency landing and later attempts to hunt the newborn.
entities.summary: A young, capable crew member and skilled mechanic expresses discomfort around military presence, hatred toward machines, and reacts to Ripley's name during a tense boarding; involved in a poker game and observed during a secretive transaction.

entities.name: Vriess
entities.description: A crew member responsible for monitoring the ship's systems and issuing critical commands during descent.
entities.summary: A legless chief mechanic in his late forties works on harvesters, interacts with Call, notices blood on Johnner, avoids alien blood, and challenges a soldier, showing mechanical skill and concern for crew safety.

entities.name: Johnner
entities.description: A crew member who observes the newborn on the vidscreen and retrieves his weapon during the attack.
entities.summary: A hostile crew member pranks Vriess, another with moonshine interacts with soldiers, one challenges Ripley leading to violence, another is confronted by her, a dealer makes misogynistic remarks, and a crew member resists detention.

entities.description: Ripley runs with exceptional speed and agility through the snowy forest, leaping over boulders and brush, ascending toward a cliff face in pursuit of the newborn.

entities.name: Ripley reaches a cliff and discovers a distant city
entities.description: After climbing a steep, rocky incline, Ripley arrives at a cliff face and sees a sprawling city on the horizon, illuminated by countless lights in the darkness.

document_metadata.title: 39、INT. THE BETTY
document_metadata.summary: Ripley escapes the dying harvester, rescues a terrified Call from alien blood, and drags her to safety as the newborn burns in flames, its skull collapsing as they cling together, covered in blood and debris.

entities.name: Newborn attacks Ripley and disables her weapon
entities.description: The newborn alien strikes Ripley before she can aim, cuts her with a tentacle, and sends her flying, preventing her from firing the grenade launcher.

entities.name: Ripley fires grenade launcher at the newborn
entities.description: Ripley grabs the grenade launcher and fires at the newborn, managing to throw it back momentarily despite being injured.

entities.name: Newborn crushes Ripley underfoot and disarms her
entities.description: The newborn slams its foot onto Ripley, causing her to scream in pain and lose the grenade launcher as it rolls away.

entities.name: Call crashes harvester into newborn to interrupt attack
entities.description: Call pilots the harvester at high speed into the newborn's head, knocking it backward and disrupting its assault on Ripley.

entities.name: Ripley falls off cliff and climbs back using rock face
entities.description: After being knocked off a cliff by the newborn's attack, Ripley falls, grabs at brush that snaps, then slides down the rockface before using her hands to dig into the rock and stop her fall, pulling herself back up.

entities.name: Call loses control of harvester after collision with newborn
entities.description: After ramming the newborn, Call is nearly thrown from the harvester as it shakes violently, and she struggles to maintain control.

entities.name: Newborn grabs harvester and confronts Call directly
entities.description: The newborn seizes the harvester after Call reverses, holding it in place and lifting its head to face Call inside the vehicle.

entities.name: Call swings harvester into tree to dislodge newborn
entities.description: Call deliberately crashes the harvester into a tree, jolting the newborn and forcing it to release its grip.

entities.name: Call performs high-speed ramming maneuver on newborn
entities.description: After maneuvering through the trees, Call reverses course and accelerates the harvester at top speed into the newborn, sending it flying and causing the harvester to flip and crash.

entities.name: Harvester crashes and traps unconscious Call
entities.description: Following the high-speed impact with the newborn, the harvester flips over and crashes against trees, landing upside down with Call trapped and unconscious beneath it.

entities.name: Ripley rushes to aid Call after climbing back to the ridge
entities.description: After pulling herself over the ridge, Ripley sees the crashed harvester and the approaching newborn, and immediately moves toward the scene to help.

entities.name: rock face
entities.description: A smooth vertical surface of rock where Ripley gains purchase with her fingers to prevent falling.

entities.name: ridge
entities.description: An elevated landform where Ripley climbs back to after falling and where she rushes to aid Call.

document_metadata.title: 39、INT. THE BETTY
document_metadata.summary: Ripley escapes the dying harvester, rescues a terrified Call from alien blood, and drags her to safety as the newborn burns in flames, its skull collapsing as they cling together, covered in blood and debris.

entities.name: Call activates the industrial shredder machine
entities.description: Call pulls the lever to start a large machine equipped with rotating blades, initiating the destruction of the alien creature.

entities.name: Machine begins shredding the alien creature
entities.description: The activated machine engages its blades, grinding and consuming layers of the alien's flesh as it thrashes in response.

entities.description: Despite Ripley's efforts to break free, the alien maintains its grip on her, keeping her in danger as the machine continues to operate.

entities.description: As the creature is shredded, its corrosive blood leaks from the machine and begins to surround Call, who is trapped beneath it.

entities.description: Realizing she is being chemically burned and unable to escape, Call is overwhelmed by a surge of terror as the pain and danger escalate.
